description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art character, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: give the bald head a hime cut: straight-cut bangs across the forehead above the eyes, two straight side locks falling in front of the ears down to the chin, and long straight hair hanging down the back to the middle of the back; seen from the front, the long hair shows on both sides behind the shoulders, the same hairstyle in both views, in big bold locks. The hair is one bright grass green, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. The long pointed ears still poke out through the hair. Do not change the face, the eyes, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
